item.description:
### Added - **Droid: reply and Stop from your phone, watch and Mac.** For a Droid session running in tmux, you can now type a message to it and stop a turn that's working. Perch checks which session the Droid terminal is in right now before sending anything, so a message never lands in a conversation you've switched away from with `/new`, `/clear` or `/sessions`. Stop is only offered while Droid is working. Neither is offered while Droid is waiting on a permission or a question, so a reply can't approve something by accident. If Perch's Droid hooks are off, both stay off and the row says why. - **Droid in Stats.** Tokens, models, active time and prompts per day for your Droid sessions, with a Droid filter alongside the other agents.
### Fixed - **Droid subagents no longer show up as sessions of their own.** Each one appeared as an extra row that read "finished", with a chime. A subagent now counts as part of the session that started it, and when it needs a permission, that session shows as waiting for you. - **A Droid question shows as waiting the moment it appears,** about a second sooner than before.
